description: Defines the Subject interface representing a subject in policy entries, including factory methods for creating Subject instances, JSON serialization, and schema version support.

classes.name: Subject
classes.description: Interface representing a policy subject with factory methods, JSON serialization, and schema version support.

classes.name: Subject.JsonFields
classes.description: Immutable class defining JSON field definitions for Subject, including schema version and type fields.

methods.name: newInstance
methods.description: Factory methods to create new Subject instances with various parameters such as issuer, subject, subject type, subject ID, etc.

methods.name: getSupportedSchemaVersions
methods.description: Returns the JSON schema versions supported by Subject (only V_2).

methods.name: getId
methods.description: Returns the ID of the Subject.

methods.name: getType
methods.description: Returns the type of the Subject.

methods.name: toJson
methods.description: Serializes the Subject to a JSON object, including only non-hidden fields.
